KS-senate.statusNote: Sen. Roger Marshall (R) faces Rev. Adam Hamilton (D), pastor of the largest Methodist church in the U.S., nominated Aug 4.

candidates.name: Roger Marshall
candidates.background: U.S. Senator since 2021; OB-GYN physician; previously represented Kansas's Big First district in the House.

health.label: Opposes 'Obamacare' and 'socialized medicine'; voted to repeal the individual mandate (Ballotpedia)

immigration.label: Supports the border wall; 'turn off the magnets' attracting migrants (Ballotpedia)

taxes.label: 'The less control the federal government has, the better off we will be' — lower taxes, less regulation (Ballotpedia)

climate.label: Opposes EPA Waters of the U.S. rules and environmental regulation of farming (Ballotpedia)

repro.label: 'Life begins at conception'; backed Heartbeat Bill, 20-week ban, defunding Planned Parenthood (Ballotpedia)

democracy.label: Objected to certifying Arizona and Pennsylvania 2020 electoral votes (Ballotpedia)

candidates.name: Adam Hamilton
candidates.background: Founding pastor of the Church of the Resurrection, the largest United Methodist congregation in the U.S.; first-time candidate running as an 'independent-minded Democrat.' Won the Aug 4 primary.

cost.label: Critical of tariffs as a cost to consumers (Christian Post platform coverage)

repro.label: 'Pro-choice on abortion' — platform statement, no further detail yet (Christian Post)
